item.title: Sprawling investigation finds decades of sexual abuse among Catholic priests in Rhode Island
item.description: Catholic priests in Rhode Island preyed on hundreds of children for decades, and were protected by bishops more concerned with the church’s reputation than the victims, according to a new report on clergy sexual abuse that echoes findings elsewhere.

item.title: Lou Holtz, college football staple who coached Notre Dame to 1988 national title, dies at 89
item.description: Lou Holtz, the College Football Hall of Fame coach who led Notre Dame to the 1988 national championship and won 249 games over 33 seasons at six schools, has died. He was 89.
